definitions.explanation: Deciding everything alone and allowing no discussion, whether as a government or as a boss, coach or parent.

examples.japanese: {独裁的|どくさいてき}な⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a dictatorial company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独裁的|どくさいてき}すぎる。
examples.english: His way of doing things is too autocratic.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独裁的|どくさいてき}な⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: In that country an autocratic regime has lasted for many years.

notes:
⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (dictatorship) + 〜⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Used of governments and, just as often, of bosses, coaches or anyone who decides everything alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独裁的|どくさいてき}な⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧: an autocratic regime
- {独裁的|どくさいてき}な⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧: a dictatorial leader
- {独裁的|どくさいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide unilaterally

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専制的|せんせいてき}: despotic — more formal, mainly of political systems
- ⟦ワンマン→ワンマン：11210_wanman⟧: autocratic (of a boss or owner who runs everything)
